**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The Senior Associate Accounts Payable is responsible for ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely processing of supplier invoices and payments globally, safeguarding financial integrity and operational efficiency. The role delivers high-quality Accounts Payable execution, supports month-end and audit processes, and acts as a reliable point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders. As part of the Finance team, this position contributes to strong financial governance, VAT compliance, and continuous process improvement, supporting the company's scalability and commercial performance. The role is a full-time position and reports to the AP Manager.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Process and validate supplier invoices, ensuring accurate coding, proper approvals, VAT compliance, and high-quality data integrity.

• Manage supplier communication and vendor onboarding, resolving invoice and payment-related queries in a timely, structured, and service-oriented manner while coordinating effectively with internal stakeholders.

• Perform monthly reconciliations, including vendor statement reconciliations, vendor subledger reviews, and balance sheet reconciliations to ensure financial accuracy and completeness.

• Support month-end closing activities by ensuring Accounts Payable accuracy and timely reporting in line with internal controls and accounting standards.

• Contribute to audit processes by providing documentation, analysis, and reconciliation support to ensure compliance and transparency.

• Drive continuous improvement within Accounts Payable processes by identifying inefficiencies, enhancing controls, and supporting automation or standardization initiatives.

• Ensure adherence to company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements, maintaining strong governance within the AP function.

**KEY EXPECTATIONS

**In this role, you take ownership of your workload, manage moderately complex tasks, and help improve processes. You work independently, propose solutions, and adapt quickly when priorities shift. Your solid knowledge makes you a dependable contributor who helps drive team performance.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

**The Impact You'll Make

**As a Customer Experience Account Manager, you will play a key role in strengthening relationships with some of our most important customers across Europe while helping create long-term customer value through strong relationships, operational excellence, and cross-functional collaboration.

You will join Danfoss Turbocor®, the pioneer and market leader in oil-free centrifugal compressor technology for commercial HVAC and refrigeration systems. As demand for sustainable cooling and heating solutions continues to grow, Danfoss Turbocor® is helping shape the future of the industry.

To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Customer Experience Account Manager who is excited to build strong customer partnerships and help deliver exceptional business outcomes.

You will act as a trusted partner to customers and internal stakeholders, helping navigate complex situations, coordinating across functions, and ensuring successful outcomes for strategic customer accounts. Your ability to combine relationship management, operational insight, and problem-solving will directly contribute to customer satisfaction, business growth, and long-term customer partnerships.

As part of a newly established and rapidly growing team, you'll have the opportunity to help shape processes, influence how we work, and make a visible impact from day one. Success in this role requires a proactive and self-driven approach, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic international environment.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**As the primary partner for your customer portfolio, you will serve as the key link between customers and the business, ensuring successful execution while strengthening long-term relationships.

**You Will

**

• Act as a trusted business partner for a portfolio of strategic customer accounts across Europe

• Coordinate complex customer requirements, major business opportunities, commercial commitments, and operational activities to ensure successful execution and long-term customer success

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and key stakeholders, creating long-term partnerships based on trust and collaboration

• Partner closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, Customer Service, and other functions to remove barriers and deliver business-critical outcomes

• Use data, insights, and analytical thinking to anticipate challenges, drive resolution, and continuously improve customer outcomes and account performance

As part of a fast-growing team, you will also contribute to establishing new ways of working, improving customer-facing processes, and helping scale a world-class customer partnership function.

**What We're Looking For

**We are looking for a proactive and relationship-oriented professional who enjoys building strong partnerships, coordinating across functions, and finding solutions in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Experience acting as a trusted partner to customers, coordinating across functions, resolving complex challenges, and building long-term business relationships

• Experience working with ERP and CRM systems, including SAP SD (Sales & Distribution) and Salesforce CRM

• Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain calm, accurate, and fact-based under pressure

• Fluency in Danish and English, along with excellent written and verbal communication skills

• The ability to manage multiple priorities, handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion, and build strong relationships across cultures, stakeholders, and functions

**Preferred Qualifications

**Experience working within manufacturing or another industry with complex products and customer requirements would be beneficial. Experience in Danfoss or a similar global matrix organization, as well as exposure to high-growth or start-up environments, would be an advantage.

Additional language skills in German, French, or Italian would be highly appreciated.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

You'll work with innovative technology that is helping transform the HVAC and refrigeration industry through more energy-efficient and sustainable solutions. You'll join a growing team where your ideas, initiative, and contributions will help shape the future of customer partnerships within the business.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're excited by the opportunity to build strong customer partnerships, work with market-leading technology, and help deliver sustainable solutions in a global environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every preferred qualification, we encourage you to apply. We recognize that different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives strengthen our teams and contribute to better outcomes for our customers and our business.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: IT Security Specialist, Security Operations - Aarhus or Gdansk
jobs.description:
Are you driven by detecting, investigating and stopping security threats, and do you want to help strengthen how a global company protects its business every day?

“Our Security Operations team protects Arla’s systems and data around the clock. In this role, you will take ownership of key parts of our detection and response capabilities, work closely with our security service providers to continuously improve them, and share your expertise with colleagues across IT,” says Poul Henrik Tang Jensen, Senior Manager, Head of IT Product.

How you will make an impact

You will join IT Security Operations within IT Foundation, where you will take ownership of assigned Security Operations capabilities across endpoint, identity, network, application and cloud environments. Our technology landscape includes Microsoft and Palo Alto security technologies across SIEM, XDR, endpoint and identity.

You will work closely with our managed security service providers, who perform much of the day-to-day security monitoring, investigation and technical execution. Your role is to ensure these services deliver the detection, response and protection capabilities Arla needs.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Taking ownership of assigned Security Operations capabilities and ensuring they remain effective, relevant and aligned with Arla’s risks and business needs.

• 
Overseeing security monitoring and investigations performed by our managed security service providers, challenging findings and providing technical direction on complex cases and incidents.

• 
Coordinating incident response across service providers and internal teams, including containment, eradication, recovery, escalation and follow-up.

• 
Driving improvements to detection rules, correlation logic, automation workflows and incident-response playbooks, working with our service providers on implementation.

• 
Assessing vulnerabilities and security-control weaknesses

• 
Managing the technical quality and performance of our security service providers, setting priorities and ensuring agreed improvements are implemented.

• 
Providing practical, risk-based security advice and assessments to projects and product teams.

• 
Leading Security Operations improvement initiatives and sharing security expertise across IT.

What will make you successful

You take ownership and follow issues through to a clear conclusion. When a security incident unfolds, you remain calm, analytical and decisive. You are comfortable working independently, while recognising when collaboration or escalation is needed. The ideal candidate brings:

• A relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT, cybersecurity or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Typically 5+ years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including substantial experience within Security Operations, security monitoring, investigation and incident response.

• Experience taking ownership of complex security investigations, incidents or operational security improvements, including coordinating technical activities across internal teams and external security providers.

• Solid technical knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR, network and identity-security monitoring, and vulnerability management.

• Practical understanding of attacker techniques and security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST and ISO 27001.

• Good understanding of security logging, telemetry, evidence collection and forensic-analysis principles.

• Good understanding of security queries, scripting and automation, enabling you to assess technical solutions, challenge implementation choices and drive improvements with security service providers.

• Experience working with and providing technical direction to managed security service providers, while collaborating effectively with internal technology and product teams.

• A relevant professional security certification, or equivalent demonstrable expertise.

• Experience with technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, KQL, Palo Alto or similar enterprise security platforms would be an advantage.

What do we offer?

This position is based in either Aarhus, Denmark or Gdansk, Poland. You will be part of an on-call rotation, approximately every seventh week, to provide support in case of critical issues.

You will join a skilled and collaborative IT Security Operations team with a central role in protecting a global market leader. You will have real ownership of our Security Operations capabilities and the opportunity to lead technical workstreams and improvement initiatives.

Would you like to join us?

If you want to help keep Arla secure and make our Security Operations capabilities even stronger, we would love to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the recruitment once the right candidate has been found.

For more information, please contact Poul Henrik Tang Jensen, Senior Manager, Head of IT Product Security Operations, at pohtj@arlafoods.com.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Procurement Category Manager for Filling equipment (Capex), Aarhus, Düsseldorf or Bremen.

Are you ambitious, driven, and looking to make a significant impact in a fast-changing environment, where you will take lead to ensure sourcing of production equipment to our dairies is optimized and cost competitive? And, do you know how to set strategic direction for your category, build and lead supplier relations to ensure a compliant and competitive supplier portfolio?

You will join a team of procurement colleagues, whom are passionate to ensure that the supplier base availably for production equipment is not just capable to deliver to quality and standards fit for future, they are also dedicated to ensure healthy competition in sourcing projects. Together with key stakeholders, we define the required sourcing strategy ahead and we aim to manage supplier relations accordingly,” says Procurement Senior Director Ninna Normand Helles.

How You Will Make an Impact

Being based in one of our offices in either Aarhus, Düsseldorf or Bremen, you will take global ownership of the Capex category of filling equipment. You will take lead to define, execute and mature the category strategies. You will manage strategic Supplier Relations and ensure to define and manage a portfolio of compliance and relevant suppliers within your category to ensure competitive sourcing can be performed in all capex projects and tenders.

Besides your category responsibility, you will take sourcing lead of key Capex projects and engage actively with the Project Manager to ensure relevant, compliant and competitive supplier selection in the project. This included definition of tender packages in the project, creation of sourcing plan in alignment with the project team, selection and onboarding of suppliers, management of tenders, negotiations and finalization of contracts.

Successfully navigating the complexity of your sourcing projects as well as your designated sourcing category, your key responsibilities will include:

• Defining and driving Category strategy, commitment and engagement of key stakeholders and execution of relevant actions to deploy strategic direction.

• Ensure a compliant and relevant supplier portfolio in your category by establishing framework agreements with relevant suppliers to cover business demand and ensure competition.

• Establishing, developing and lead strong, long-lasting and dynamic supplier relationships and ensure annual SRM plans are conducted.

• Lead and manage execution all sourcing activities in key Capex projects with high level of complexity and time dependencies, including sourcing plan, supplier selection, tendering, negotiation and contracting.

• Set sourcing and negotiation strategy and take lead to execute accordingly to ensure competitive sourcing and objective supplier evaluation and rewarding.

• Working closely together with key stakeholder internally to ensure successful and competitive execution of sourcing projects.

• Conduct supplier and site visits to maintain knowledge of equipment and competences and challenges among suppliers as well as internally at Arla sites.

In terms of travel, you can expect approximately 20-30 days per year to maintain supplier relations and visit Arla dairies at various locations in Europe.

What Will Make You Successful

Your qualifications include a Master’s degree and at least 5 years of experience in a similar role from a global organization. Your innate project management mindset, coupled with strong analytical skills, allows you to seamlessly transition from a high-level strategic view to execution and diving deep for valuable insights. You excel in business partnering, building positive relationships, and effectively managing stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Your thoughtful communication and flexible project management ensure smooth and efficient processes.

Having profound understanding of complex negotiations, capex contracts, and the commercial and strategic aspects behind them is equally important in this role. Your experience therefor includes, but is not limited to:

• At least 5 years of extensive experience in strategic sourcing related to Capex/production equipment.

• Profound experience as sourcing lead of complex tender projects and negotiations.

• Experienced Category Management and know how to set and drive a category strategy, and how to establish a compliant and relevant supplier portfolio for your category.

• Good technical understanding and knowledge of Capex/production equipment and understanding of the supplier base across capex categories. Specific knowledge from the food and beverage industry, is a considerable advantage.

• Your fluency in spoken and written English is excellent.

You are fearless when it comes to challenging the status quo, and your courage and exceptional stakeholder management skills empower you to negotiate effectively and rally the right individuals when introducing new ideas. Your genuine interest in our business field drives you to proactively conduct research, ensuring a deep understanding of the global supply market. You thrive in a dynamic, international work environment where objectives and priorities are continuously evolving and developing.

What Do We Offer?

Join a high-performing team with a great culture and spirit, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop your skills and make a real impact. At Arla, we’re committed to professional growth and promoting from within. Our positive and collaborative culture brings out the best in everyone, and you’ll be part of a market leader that produces nutritious, household-favorite brands in a sustainable way - benefiting customers, our farmer-owners, and the world.

Would You Like to Join Us?

We are conducting interviews for this position on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible. For additional information, please submit our application without further hesitation, as we will close the recruitment when the right candidate has been found.

In case of further questions, you may contact Procurement Senior Director Ninna Normand Helles at ninoh@arlafoods.com

Our global procurement organization is spread across Denmark, Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, UK, Poland, and Hong Kong. This position will report to Senior Procurement Director of Capex, MRO, utilities and chemicals.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: 170023 Professor of Psychotherapy (Part-Time or Clinical Appointment, Fixed-Term for 5 Years)
jobs.description:
Professor of Psychotherapy
 (Part-Time or Clinical Appointment, Fixed-Term for 5 Years)

  Department of Clinical Medicine
 Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
  University of Copenhagen

  The University of Copenhagen invites applications for a professorship in Psychotherapy. Depending on the qualifications and current position of the successful applicant, the appointment will be made either as a part-time professor combined with a senior researcher position, or as a clinical professor combined with a consultancy at one of the hospitals listed below.

  • Copenhagen University Hospital, Bispebjerg and Frederiksberg, the Mental Health Centre Copenhagen

  • Copenhagen University Hospital – Herlev and Gentofte, Center Stolpegaard

  It is a requirement for appointment that the applicant is accepted for both the professorship and the consultancy/position as senior researcher. In order to be considered for the position, the applicant must send two applications: one to the Faculty (the professorship) and one to the hospital (the consultancy/senior researcher position) cf. the simultaneously advertised position of the consultancy/position as senior researcher. This also applies to applicants who are already employed at one of the hospitals. The advertisements for the consultancies/senior researcher positions are available at:

   	
• Copenhagen University Hospital, Bispebjerg and Frederiksberg: https://www.sundhedsjobs.dk 	
• Copenhagen University Hospital – Herlev and Gentofte: https://www.sundhedsjobs.dk   Both the professorship and the consultancy/position as senior researcher will be financed by the relevant hospital.

  Find information about the department.

  Job description
 In the consideration of applications for the professorship, the main emphasis will be on the applicant's ability to document a high level of original scientific work at an international level within the area of psychiatry or psychology.

  The professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research, including publication/academic dissemination. The realization of psychotherapeutic treatment of patients with psychiatric disorders, including new technologies, implies great potential. The professorship aims to ensure the scientific development of psychotherapeutic treatment of patients with psychiatric disorders, including outcome - and process studies, and new technologies as a supplement to psychotherapeutic practice, and to ensure implementation in clinical practice.   	
• Research-based teaching, including associated examination. The professor shall conduct research-based teaching in psychotherapy within different psychiatric disorders, including new technologies. 	
• Research leadership, including guidance and supervision of researchers. The professor shall overall plan and develop research initiatives within psychotherapy and aid in implementing results into clinical practice. 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society, including participation in public debate 	
• Academic assessments   Required qualifications 
 To be qualified for a professorship, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, Teaching, Innovation & Societal impact, Organizational contribution, and Leadership. Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact. Find information about each criterion.

  Furthermore, each applicant must be able to:

   	
• Document a high degree of original academic production at an international level, including considerable contributions to the development of the academic discipline 	
• Manage research and other management functions, e.g. engage in the university’s external academic activities, as well as knowledge and technology transfer 	
• Provide research-based teaching   The professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

  Terms of employment 
 The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025. The position is a fixed-term positions limited to a period of five years. Extension is possible.

  The employers in the combined position may, where necessary, exchange information regarding matters that are of significant relevance to the employment relationship.

  Terms of employment especially for the professor (part time)
 For the position as professor the average weekly working hours are approximately 11 hours per week. Salary and other terms and conditions of appointment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations.

  This form of employment shall remain in effect until, pursuant to the applicable Job structure for Aacademic Staff, the appointment of non-medical professionals as Clinical Professors becomes possible and an agreement on salary and employment terms for such positions has been concluded with the relevant professional organisations. Upon fulfilment of these conditions, the employment shall be converted to an appointment as Clinical Professor, in accordance with the description set out below.

  Terms of employment especially for the clinical professor
 For the clinical professorship the appointee will receive a pensionable annual honorarium of 219.882,33 DKK (1 August 2026 level)

  Questions
 For further information please contact Head of Department Nicolai W. Albrechtsen, nicolai.albrechtsen@regionh.dk.

  Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.

  Application
 The application must be submitted in English and must include the following documents:

   	
• Application (Including motivations for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s and PhD and other relevant certificates) 	
• Uploads of maximum 10 publications to be considered in the assessment 	
• Self-declaration form (Template under ‘Nyttige links’ - Upload the completed and mandatory form as “Other relevant material”) 	
• Teaching portfolio (Guidelines / Template for inspiration under Nyttige links) 	
• Research plan (3‐5 pages) 	
• Teaching plan 	
• A complete list of publications   Application procedure 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee. When the assessment committee has completed the assessment, each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.

  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested applicants to apply for this position.

  Please submit the application with the required attachments. The closing date for applications is 23.59 p.m. CET, Wednesday, 9 December 2026.

  Interviews for this position are likely to be held on 19 April 2027.

jobs.occupation: Management Consultants in Supply Chain Planning – Graduates 2027
jobs.description:
We're looking for talented and curious graduates who want to start a career in management consulting at the intersection of deep functional expertise and digital planning solutions.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll be joining a nerdy team that designs and delivers optimal supply chains by combining best-in-class processes with leading digital solutions. Every day, we help clients transform their planning processes in demand, supply, and inventory optimisation across the value chain and planning horizons.

You’ll be working on a wide range of projects. Depending on your personal journey and development goals, your role in a project could include:

• 
Design and implement planning excellence: Apply advanced concepts in forecasting, demand and supply planning, S&OP/IBP, inventory optimisation, and operational planning to build robust, end‑to‑end planning processes.

• 
Enable adoption and capability building: Train stakeholders and facilitate client workshops to co-create designs, refine processes, and embed continuous improvement.

• 
Translate requirements into actionable processes: Convert business needs into well-defined process designs and implementation plans – with clear governance, data, and decision flows.

• 
Guide digital planning transformations: Advise clients on solution architecture and roadmaps for SAP IBP and other leading platforms from concept to configuration and adoption.

• 
Deliver measurable impact: Execute projects that optimise planning tools and processes, strengthen performance management, and build organisational capabilities that sustain excellence.

If this sounds like the kind of nerdery you would like to dive deep into, you’ll feel right at home in our team.

Please note this role is based in our Copenhagen office.

What you’ll bring

As our new team member, you’ll be working at the forefront of supply chain transformation – integrating digital enablers with core business functions to create end-to-end impact, from strategy and design to implementation and adoption.

To be a great fit, you hold – or are about to complete – a master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, supply chain, operations research, or business analytics, with strong academic results to show for it.

On top of that, we’re looking for someone who meets most of the following criteria:

• 
Relevant experience: Ideally, you’ve applied supply chain concepts through an internship, student role, or thesis project.

• 
Project-driven and adaptable: You enjoy working in a project-based setting, managing timelines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.

• 
Interest in digital tools: Ideally, you have exposure to SAP (e.g., SAP IBP) or other digital planning platforms or you are interested in building expertise in digital planning solutions.

• 
Analytical problem-solver: You love turning complex problems into clear insights and actionable solutions.

• 
Structured communicator: You can structure and deliver compelling presentations and workshops in English (proficiency in another European language is a plus, but not a requirement).

Supply chains are becoming one of the most strategically important – and technically complex – areas in business. If you want to be at the sharp end of that, join our team where curiosity is rewarded, diverse perspectives are valued, and where you will make an impact from day one.

What we offer

At Implement, a healthy, dynamic, and collaborative environment always comes first. You'll become part of a fast-growing, entrepreneurial Scandinavian consultancy that gives you the space to grow, lead, and innovate while creating real results for our clients.

• 
Build deep functional expertise: develop mastery across demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimisation, S&OP/IBP, and digital planning tools with ownership of end-to-end planning transformations.

• 
Hands-on from day one: work on client projects immediately, side by side with experienced consultants who elevate your strategic thinking and methodological rigour.

• 
Continuous development: get access to an ambitious internal training programme with keynotes, workshops, certifications, and mentoring to accelerate your professional and personal growth.

• 
High-trust culture: enjoy autonomy, support, and a flat hierarchy in a team that shares knowledge freely and continuously raises its standards.

• 
International environment: work on planning transformation projects for global clients, collaborating across cultures, industries, and markets on programmes that deliver measurable impact.

Make your next move matter.

How to apply

Please include your CV, a cover letter, and your GPA for both your BSc and MSc.

Start date for this position is flexible, either winter 2026/2027 or September/October 2027.

About Implement

Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consulting firm with 1,900+ employees. Headquartered in Copenhagen, we have 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States, making us one of the largest European consultancies. We support organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. To help our clients succeed with their most critical change initiatives, we aim to attract, develop, and promote the best talent by creating a unique, collaborative learning environment where people can follow their passion, shape their own careers, and choose their own leaders.

**Location: Copenhagen

**We are seeking a strategic and solutions-oriented Director, Creative Operations to lead the operational backbone of our in-house creative team. As a key leader within the organization, you will be responsible for driving efficiency, optimizing workflows, and enabling the seamless delivery of creative work for a global audience.

This role will lead project management, creative operations systems, technology enablement, and external agency partnerships to ensure our teams deliver best-in-class creative work at scale. You will collaborate closely with Digital & Technology, Brand, Marketing, and Production teams to shape and evolve the creative operating model, lead technology initiatives, and identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, and efficiency through automation and emerging technologies.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized and collaborative leader with deep expertise in creative operations, workflow transformation, technology implementation, and change management. You are equally comfortable developing long-term operational strategies and ensuring day-to-day execution excellence.

**Creative Operations & Project Management

**

• Lead the Creative Studio operating model, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, resource allocation, and project delivery.

• Drive continuous improvement of creative workflows, systems, and governance across project management, DAM, and MRM platforms.

• Partner with Creative, Brand, Marketing Operations, Production, and Technology teams to align priorities, optimize resources, and ensure successful delivery.

• Establish operational KPIs and reporting to measure workflow effectiveness, resource utilization, delivery performance, and business impact.

• Lead and develop Creative Operations capabilities through coaching, best practices, and process excellence.

**Technology, AI & Operational Excellence

**

• Partner with Digital & Technology teams to evaluate, select, and implement creative technology solutions, including DAM, workflow, automation, and AI-enabled tools.

• Develop business cases and investment plans that improve creative effectiveness, operational efficiency, and scalability.

• Establish governance, adoption frameworks, and responsible-use practices for AI and emerging technologies.

• Monitor industry trends and translate innovation into practical improvements across creative operations and content production.

**Agency & Vendor Management

**

• Lead relationships with external design, localization, customization, and technology partners, ensuring alignment with brand, quality, budget, and delivery expectations.

• Manage SOWs, contracts, performance metrics, and ongoing vendor effectiveness.

• Evaluate partner capabilities and identify opportunities to leverage innovation, automation, and emerging production models.

**Change Management & Transformation

Product Management at Dalux – Turning Information into Attention

Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.

• Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.

• Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.

• Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.

• Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.

• Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.

• Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.

• Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.

• Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We believe you:

• Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.

The role

You'll have room to shape how Application Management works at Hemab, deciding what we need now, what can wait and where external partners make more sense than building internally.

What you'll do

• Lead business system implementations from business case and solution selection through go-live, adoption and ongoing management.

• Turn business needs into practical technology solutions that fit Hemab's priorities, architecture and stage of growth.

• Own vendor selection, including RFI/RFP activities, solution evaluation and recommendations.

• Manage implementation partners and application vendors, holding them accountable for delivery, quality and service.

• Work with business owners to make sure systems, controls, training and ways of working are ready before launch.

• Establish application lifecycle management covering performance, upgrades, changes, renewals and vendor relationships.

• Partner with System Owners and Quality to keep regulated and GxP applications compliant and appropriately controlled.

• Build change and release management capabilities, using external specialists where appropriate.

• Work across Quality, Information Security, Data & AI, Legal and IT Operations to make sound technology decisions and build internal capabilities as Hemab grows.

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Experience working with regulated systems in biotech, pharma or another regulated life-sciences environment.

• Practical knowledge of GxP requirements, system lifecycle management and the controls needed to maintain compliance.

• Experience managing application vendors, implementation partners and outsourced services.

• Evidence of delivering complex, cross-functional technology projects while managing competing business needs.

Nice to have

• Experience helping a biotech scale from early clinical development towards later-stage maturity.

• Experience building an Application Management function or introducing new ways of working.

• Experience establishing change and release management using external partners.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. Whoever takes this role will likely build some of their own process instead of inheriting a finished one. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. If you want a place where the operating manual is already written, this might not be it – but if you want to help write it, this might be exactly it.

_Do you also feel energized by super smooth Operations and a beautiful CI/CD setup? Do you eat Kubernetes and Azure for breakfast? And do you thrive in a sometimes-unpredictable environment where you jump in and save the day? Then we believe we have something great to offer.

****Experience?

**

**

As Finance Business Partner for the Markets IT Development area, you will translate financial insight into decisions that shape how three Tribes operate and invest. ****Job Description:

jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As Project Director, you will lead the most complex sourcing projects in Drug Substance, from category strategy through to signed contracts with CMOs, where commitments can exceed DKK 1 billion. You will shape strategies for areas of growing importance to Novo, such as synthetic peptides, and negotiate partnerships that are strong commercially and sustainable over time. Your work helps keep the supply of treatments for people living with serious chronic diseases reliable.

What you’ll bring

You are a senior sourcing and project leader who combines a strategic mindset with an eye for contractual detail.

**You Have

**

• A university master’s degree in pharmacy, biology, engineering, supply chain management, law or business.

• Around 15+ years of relevant pharmaceutical experience, in manufacturing, manufacturing development and/or CMO environments. The role may suit candidates with around 20 years of experience.

• A strong background in strategic sourcing, contract negotiation and external partner management.

• Solid experience leading complex, cross-functional projects, as project and/or line manager.

• In-depth knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing, CMOs, quality and regulatory requirements.

• Excellent negotiation and contracting skills, and the ability to engage with senior management and CMO executives, up to CEO level.

• The ability to lead and influence without formal authority, with resilience, autonomy, a sense of urgency and strong execution skills.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Supplementary training in areas such as cGMP, project execution or personal development.

• An existing network within Novo, CMOs and pharmaceutical engineering companies.

• Experience in Drug Product sourcing.

What you’ll do

You will own sourcing projects from the first idea to final implementation, and you will keep strategy, contract and delivery pointing in the same direction.

**In Practice, You Will

**

• Develop category strategies for areas of strategic importance, such as synthetic peptides, by pairing market insight, including global players and trends, with Novo’s strategic outlook.

• Lead critical CMO negotiations independently until signature, securing outcomes within mandate that balance value, cost, flexibility, speed and risk.

• Drive projects end-to-end: set up governance and Steering Committees, build business cases and plans, define deliverables and manage risk.

• Bring together specialists from MSAT, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Finance and Legal, and raise bottlenecks early so work keeps moving.

• Keep SVP and EVP-level stakeholders informed and aligned on progress, and give input to business plans and budgets.

• Raise the standard for how Drug Substance Outsourcing works by sharing your approach with category managers and developing sourcing standards.

Who you’ll work with

You will be a senior individual contributor in GSOD Drug Substance Outsourcing, reporting to the Senior Director of the department. The role has no direct reports, but you will lead through influence: category groups and project teams with specialists from MSAT, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, Finance and Legal, as well as colleagues in Global Contract Manufacturing DS, Supply Chain Design, GMS Management and country affiliates.

Externally, you will work with CMOs across the US, Europe and Asia, so you should expect to spend significant time abroad. You will balance partnership and long-term collaboration with the best possible commercial terms for Novo, and you will be at ease handling cross-cultural discussions when tension runs high.

In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain to scale molecules, processes, devices and products for the people who need them. Your primary focus will be Drug Substance, with potential involvement in Drug Product and Devices.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to take decisions independently and to give strategic guidance to senior leaders on the project portfolio. You will build new skills through cross-functional and cross-border work, and you will be recognised for results through clear performance expectations.

You will also have room to challenge convention: to find faster, better ways to run projects and to shape new processes and standards for CMO partnerships.

The pay range for this role is 940,800 – 1,448,700 DKK per year. The final offer reflects your experience and qualifications.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead Novo’s most strategic CMO partnerships from strategy to signature, apply for the Project Director role by 19st November 2026 . We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Uffe Holme ufho@novonordisk.com
